description: The example decks in examples/decks/: the family each belongs to (the paper or study, also the example script examples/<family>.py groups by), whether front ends hide it from their example lists, and a one-line summary. Titles and descriptions are read from the decks. Every deck must be listed (ExampleDeckManifest checks).
